adventure.name: Corrupted Memories
adventure.description: Trovian! The Bosses of the Delve caverns can spread corruption even to inanimate objects! If not consumed, these objects will Decay and their corruption will be released back into the Delve caverns, or–worse–Trove and Geode themselves!
